ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: The solutions in the two arms of a U-shaped tube are separated by a membrane that is permeable to water and sodium chloride but impermeable to sucrose. Side A is filled with a solution of 0.6 M sucrose and 0.2 M sodium chloride (NaCl), and side B is filled with a solution of 0.2 M sucrose and 0.3 M NaCl, with the volumes on the two sides initially the same. At the start of the experiment, what tonicity relationship does side A have relative to side B?
ready1_open_rewrite.expected_answer: Side A is hypertonic relative to side B

The conclusion is that side A is hypertonic relative to side B.

method.method_draft: 先看图：U 形管左侧标为 Side A，右侧标为 Side B，中间由膜分隔。再读题：这层膜允许水和 NaCl 通过，但不允许蔗糖通过。判断张力时只看不能通过膜的溶质，所以只比较蔗糖浓度，不把可透过的 NaCl 算入。A 侧蔗糖为 0.6 M，B 侧蔗糖为 0.2 M，因此 A 侧的不可透过溶质更高，A 侧相对于 B 侧是高渗的。
